header='''"""Camera-guided RoboCasa GR1 controller and its authored command record.

The live episode was controlled interactively using RGB/depth, camera calibration,
and proprioception only. Each waypoint below was chosen after reviewing those
observations. No resets, simulator internals, demonstrations, or trained policies
were used. The final command keeps the left hand against the closed door.

This file records the completed episode. Do not execute it again on that episode.
Use --execute only when intentionally running this command record on a service.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

BASE_R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
BASE_T = np.array([2.65, -2.175, 0.97])

# World-frame position waypoints; axis-angle targets are in the robot base frame.
# Hand channels: little, ring, middle, index, thumb flexion, thumb rotation.
'''
body='WAYPOINTS = '+repr(history)+'\n\n'
footer='''def camera_point(obs, camera, u, v):
    """Unproject an observed depth pixel using that observation's calibration."""
    depth = obs.depth[camera]
    if depth.ndim == 3:
        depth = depth[-1]
    calibration = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(calibration["intrinsic_cv"])
    T = np.asarray(calibration["cam2world_gl"])
    z = float(depth[int(v), int(u)])
    ray = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0],
                    -(v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], -z])
    return T[:3, :3] @ ray + T[:3, 3]


def run():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    cameras = list(spec["cameras"])
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="none")
    proprio = dict(zip(obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"],
                       obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
    layout = spec["action_types"]["ee_pose"]["layout"]
    command = np.array([proprio["cmd_" + name] for name in layout])
    destination = Path(__file__).parent / "command_record_run"
    for index, waypoint in enumerate(WAYPOINTS):
        target = command.copy()
        for key, offset in (("right", 0), ("left", 6)):
            if waypoint[key] is not None:
                target[offset:offset+3] = BASE_R.T @ (np.asarray(waypoint[key])-BASE_T)
        for key, start, stop in (("rrot", 3, 6), ("lrot", 9, 12),
                                 ("rhand", 12, 18), ("lhand", 18, 24)):
            if waypoint[key] is not None:
                target[start:stop] = waypoint[key]
        ramp = np.linspace(command, target, waypoint["n"]+1)[1:]
        actions = np.vstack((ramp, np.tile(target, (waypoint["hold"], 1))))
        obs = robot.submit("ee_pose", actions, cameras=cameras,
                           include_depth=True, video="none", note=waypoint["note"])
        obs.save(str(destination / f"{index:03d}"))
        command = target
    # Stop here: no settling, retraction, reset, or further control requests.


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.execute:
        run()
    else:
        print(f"Recorded {len(WAYPOINTS)} authored motions. Execution disabled by default.")
'''
(out/'gen.py').write_text(header+body+footer)
